tests.name: Verify cycle unrest, event, disruption accounting and population conservation

data.sql: SELECT (SELECT slave_unrest_level=92 FROM planets WHERE name='v3_unrest_slave_qa')::int, (SELECT COUNT(*)=1 AND bool_and(e.disrupted=(e.disruption_roll<e.disruption_probability)) FROM planet_slave_production_events e JOIN planets p USING(planet_id) WHERE p.name='v3_unrest_slave_qa')::int, (SELECT s.quantity=CASE WHEN e.disrupted THEN 0 ELSE 2 END FROM planets p JOIN entity_stock s ON s.entity_type='planet' AND s.entity_id=p.planet_id AND s.commodity_code='ORE' JOIN planet_slave_production_events e USING(planet_id) WHERE p.name='v3_unrest_slave_qa')::int, (SELECT population>=100 AND colonists_ore=100 FROM planets WHERE name='v3_unrest_slave_qa')::int, (SELECT s.quantity=5 FROM planets p JOIN entity_stock s ON s.entity_type='planet' AND s.entity_id=p.planet_id AND s.commodity_code='ORE' WHERE p.name='v3_unrest_colonist_qa')::int, (SELECT slave_unrest_level=0 FROM planets WHERE name='v3_unrest_colonist_qa')::int, (SELECT s.quantity=2 FROM planets p JOIN entity_stock s ON s.entity_type='planet' AND s.entity_id=p.planet_id AND s.commodity_code='ORE' WHERE p.name='v3_unrest_slave_ratio_qa')::int, (SELECT COUNT(*)=1 AND bool_and(NOT e.disrupted AND e.disruption_probability=0 AND s.quantity=FLOOR((SELECT quantity FROM entity_stock xs JOIN planets xp ON xp.planet_id=xs.entity_id WHERE xs.entity_type='planet' AND xs.commodity_code='ORE' AND xp.name='v3_unrest_colonist_qa')/2.0)::bigint) FROM planet_slave_production_events e JOIN planets p USING(planet_id) JOIN entity_stock s ON s.entity_type='planet' AND s.entity_id=p.planet_id AND s.commodity_code='ORE' WHERE p.name='v3_unrest_slave_ratio_qa')::int;

tests.name: Verify repeated tick does not duplicate event, output or unrest

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT slave_unrest_level=92 FROM planets WHERE name='v3_unrest_slave_qa') AND (SELECT COUNT(*)=1 FROM planet_slave_production_events e JOIN planets p USING(planet_id) WHERE p.name='v3_unrest_slave_qa') AND (SELECT quantity=CASE WHEN e.disrupted THEN 0 ELSE 2 END FROM entity_stock s JOIN planets p ON p.planet_id=s.entity_id JOIN planet_slave_production_events e ON e.planet_id=p.planet_id WHERE p.name='v3_unrest_slave_qa' AND s.commodity_code='ORE') AND (SELECT quantity=2 FROM entity_stock s JOIN planets p ON p.planet_id=s.entity_id WHERE p.name='v3_unrest_slave_ratio_qa' AND s.commodity_code='ORE') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;
DELETE FROM entity_stock WHERE entity_type='planet' AND entity_id IN (SELECT planet_id FROM planets WHERE name IN ('v3_unrest_slave_qa','v3_unrest_colonist_qa','v3_unrest_slave_ratio_qa'))
